observer_contract.gate_cycle_success: strict majority: at least 4 of 6 gate deltas are >0; zero/nonpositive deltas are non-success
observer_contract.required_cross_cycle_condition: cycles are independent inferential blocks and each null cycle-success probability is <=1/2
observer_contract.sufficient_null_condition: independent cycles plus central sign symmetry of each six-dimensional gate-difference vector
information_lost_by_block_observer: which literal orders supplied the positive signs

global_claim.form: strict conjunction: AB directional superiority AND CB directional superiority
global_claim.proof: Under the union null at least one component null is true; global rejection is contained in rejection of that true component, so P(global reject)<=0.05.
global_claim.separate_simultaneous_claims_boundary: If AB and CB must each be reported as separately alpha-controlled simultaneous claims, keep Bonferroni alpha=0.025 per gate instead.

power_and_budget.assumption: independent cycles; for each component gate every cycle has alternative success probability at least p_block
power_and_budget.recommendation: For a future strictly conjunctive confirmatory run, if p_block≈0.8 is a defensible planning alternative, 18 independent complete cycles gives >0.8 marginal power per gate; 23 cycles gives >0.9 marginal power per gate and, without any AB/CB independence assumption, a Frechet lower bound >0.8 for both gates passing. Five cycles is only an alpha-resolution minimum and is severely underpowered.

negative_control.AC_role: diagnostic veto, not a confirmatory alternative
negative_control.cluster_note: The frozen triplet-level AC 17/24 calibration is also invalid under arbitrary within-cycle dependence. If a formal false-veto rate is desired, calibrate AC on the same independent cycle blocks; otherwise keep AC descriptive/veto-only.

boundary: The frozen 6D3A91 manifest is not retroactively modified; its four-cycle 18/24 statistics remain descriptive unless a stronger dependence model is justified.
Cycle balance alone does not establish central sign symmetry or independence across cycles.
No native spectralDNS/shenfun/MPI/FFTW execution was performed.
